content.title: A Fortunate Universe: Life in a Finely Tuned Cosmos
content.author: Geraint F. Lewis and Luke A. Barnes (Cambridge University Press, 2016)
content.note: Two astrophysicists set out the evidence that the constants and initial conditions of physics fall in narrow life-permitting ranges, and the possible responses. Lewis is not a theist; Barnes is a Christian. They do not argue for God. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
